title: Bcc Guard
summary: Shows the To line as each recipient will see it, so a group email doesn't expose everyone's names and addresses to each other.
description: Previews the To line as one recipient sees it, counts the names, private addresses and companies exposed, flags lists where membership is itself sensitive ("HIV", "arrears"), moves outside recipients to Bcc in one tap with Undo, and asks for a second press to send.
catches: Recipients who can see each other's addresses on To or Cc
Addresses or display names that give away a person's name, and outside companies
Subjects or bodies with terms that make being on the list sensitive
Sending while addresses still show, with options to move them to Bcc or send one email each
limits: Sensitive-term matching uses a word list (replaceable); other sensitive contexts are missed
Internal vs outside is decided only by the internalDomains you pass
It cannot stop replies-all or forwards after sending
a11y: The preview is labelled by its heading (aria-labelledby)
Focus moves to the next sensible action (Move to Bcc, then Send)
The second-press warning uses role="alert" and the Send button is described by it
Status is announced in a role="status" region; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion
mistakes: newsletter sent with everyone in to
